description: Read-only chain-wide Explorer DB transaction search. Use for general transaction, native XGR value, from/to address, hash, input, session id, validity/execution, and block/time-range questions; do not sample XDaLa sessions for chain-wide transaction questions.

contractCreation.description: Value for the contract creation parameter.

from.description: Sender address or lower bound used for the query.

fromBlock.description: Value for the from block parameter.

hasInput.description: Value for the has input parameter.

hasValue.description: Value for the has value parameter.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

page.description: One-based page number for paginated explorer/API results.

sessionId.description: XDaLa session identifier used to query runtime or explorer data.

to.description: Recipient address, contract address or upper bound used for the query.

toBlock.description: Value for the to block parameter.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash to inspect or resolve.

valueEqWei.description: Value for the value eq wei parameter.

valueGtWei.description: Value for the value gt wei parameter.

valueLtWei.description: Value for the value lt wei parameter.

windowHours.description: Value for the window hours parameter.

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.
